generate_gt_estimation_csv: run the script to generate a CSV of ground truth pose estimations for BOP dataset testing
load_scene_gt: use inout.load_scene_gt to load ground truth pose data for a specific scene from a numpy file
load_json_with_int_keys: use inout.load_json with keys_to_int=True to load scene ground truth info with integer keys
get_split_params: use dataset_params.get_split_params to retrieve dataset split configuration including paths for a given dataset and split
filter_poses_by_visibility: run the script with min_visib_gt parameter to filter ground truth poses by minimum visibility fraction
